fact: In the pilot results delivered on 17 November 2025 for the first twelve months in Golfe 3 commune (since April 2024), more than 3,062 births and 759 deaths were teledeclared through Hospi-Connect, operational in 5 health establishments of the commune, with progressive national extension expected.
title: La phase pilote de la télédéclaration des naissances livre ses premiers résultats
